GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)

   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa? (1 mark)

   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour
